decisions.reason: It is close to the firm's existing hosting and compliance know-how, supported by in-house R&D and continued web presence, so management is likely to see enough related knowledge to improve rather than withdraw it.
As a flagship platform built directly on the firm's core web hosting capabilities and still featured on the home page, it fits the firm's knowledge base and strategic direction very strongly.

A configurable managed hosting plan sits squarely within the firm's established offer, and its continued dedicated presentation suggests acceptable traction and strong scope for learning-based refinement.

Although newer and less prominently presented, extended PHP security support is highly related to the firm's technical service and security expertise, so a firm with its own R&D would usually retain it to learn and build on customer demand.
